meta.title: What moves this branch — top-2 macro drivers per branch (portfolio risk, objective #1)
meta.label: ESTIMATED PROXY OVER MEASURED INPUTS — real Pink Sheet price YoY (GLOBAL direction proxy, not Thai farm-gate) and measured OAE crop shares / rainfall / OSM gold-shop counts, combined through ESTIMATED branch relevance weights (segment scores a/c are estimated 0-100 screens). A ranking of which macro lever moves each branch's book — NOT a measured elasticity or default rate.

provenance.price_signals: MEASURED — World Bank Pink Sheet YoY via source-data/commodity_board.json (vintage 2026M06). GLOBAL prices, a direction proxy, NOT Thai farm-gate.
provenance.crop_shares: MEASURED — OAE planting-area shares per province (platform/data/crop_stress.json crop_mix)
provenance.drought: MEASURED PROXY — 3-month rainfall %% of normal (crop_stress.json components.rain_pct_of_normal)
provenance.gold_shops: MEASURED — OSM gold shops ≤10km per branch (branches.json k10.gold)
provenance.relevance_weights: ESTIMATED — branch agri/collateral segment scores (branches.json a/c, estimated 0-100 OSM/price screens) scale the driver relevance

meta.formula: score = round(100 × severity × relevance). Crops: sev=clamp(|yoy|/25,0,1), rel=crop_share×(a/100). Gold: rel=(c/100)×min(1,gold_shops/5). Drought: sev=province drought(0..1), rel=(a/100)×crop_dependence. dir: 't' tailwind when price YoY>0, else 'h'; drought is headwind-only. t2 = top-2 by score desc (fixed driver order tie-break).
meta.score_scale: RELATIVE 0-100 but diluted by measured shares and estimated segment scores — a crop driver rarely exceeds ~50 while gold can near 100 in dense urban gold-trade catchments. Compare ORDER, not magnitude.
meta.rec_format: branches[i] = t2 = up to 2 of [driver_key, score, 'h'|'t', ctx] — ctx meaning per driver is meta.drivers[key].ctx_label. INDEX-ALIGNED to branches.json (entry i ↔ branch i).
meta.province_format: provinces[] = macro watchlist: modal TOP driver per province, headwind-dominant first. hits = branches whose #1 driver it is; avg_score share-diluted (est).
meta.gaps: Bueng Kan has no OAE crop_stress entry: crop drivers read 0 there and drought falls back to the branch's own measured rain field, clamp((100-rain)/40), at full agri relevance (15 branches). No fuel / used-vehicle / manufacturing price series exists in the offline sources, so those levers are NOT scored — see build_macro_exposure.py for the occupation-weighted view that models the manufacturing cycle editorially.
